podcast.body: This album featured the studio version of Rage Against the Machine's cover of Bruce Springsteen's "The Ghost of Tom Joad," which had previously appeared on their 1997 VHS concert album and was also released as a single. "It was later released as a single and also showed up on the 2000 album Renegades."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This album was a collection of covers released when the band did not manage to write any new original songs for a potential fourth studio album. It included a cover of Bruce Springsteen's "The Ghost of Tom Joad," which had been a staple in Rage's live performances for years and was also featured on a 1997 video collection. "The result was a collection of covers called Renegades. It featured a cover of a Bruce Springsteen song that became one of Tom Morello's all-time favorites."
